text:
maya: Heads-up — we're running a cross-AZ eviction simulation next Tue 2025-11-11 02:00 UTC (maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC). Purpose: validate routing/fallback and SLO behavior during AZ-scale instance preemptions. Run will be staged and reversible. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az-eviction-sim
jordan: Thanks — what’s the expected customer impact? SLO windows we should watch?
maya: Expected: short-lived p95 bumps for some routes during controlled evictions, p99 should remain within 2x baseline for <5% of requests. We’ll exercise the routing fallback and model-variant failover. Primary dashboards: "slo/latency-by-route", "routing/fallback-counts". Post-run expected follow-up + quick postmortem.
kai: Are Dedicated pools included in this sim or only hosted clusters?
maya: Dedicated pools are excluded by default unless you opt-in. If a team has pinned nodes in the targeted AZ, please reply with "opt-in" in this thread. Otherwise we will skip those pools.
sam: @oncall — can you add a short smoke test after each stage? I’ll coordinate traces.
maya: Yep — plan is: 3 staged evictions, run smoke after each. Smoke test command (curl health):
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_KEY" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/health | jq '.status'
```
observability-bot: Dashboards updated: https://observability.redwood.internal/d/eviction-sim/overview — streaming logs flagged with tag "eviction-sim-1765432100" :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Scheduled job `eviction-sim-1765432100` created for 2025-11-11T02:00:00Z. Stages: dry-run, canary-25%, canary-100%. Creator: maya.
jordan: Quick question — what fallback model variants will be used? small-latency / high-accuracy tiers?
maya: Fallback policy: prefer same-arch quantized variants first (if available), then regional cheaper variants. Full policy in runbook section 3.2. Teams that need specific variant pinning, ping me.
--- (02:05 UTC) ---
sam: Running first-stage smoke: health checks green, but I’m seeing a brief p95 spike to 180ms in eu-west-1 during the canary transition.
maya: Copy that — can you paste a trace id? Tag traces with `eviction-sim-1765432100` so we can correlate.
jordan: Sample log excerpt from router (trimmed):
```
[02:04:58Z] route=set:model-gen-1 host=router-07 fallback=1 latency_ms=185 trace_id=01FAR...abc
```
sam: Trace 01FARxyzabc posted to observability under tag; initial analysis shows KV cache miss during switch.
maya: Good signal. Will pause before next stage and adjust KV warmup window to 10s. Notating change in runbook. Will resume in ~8m.
kai: Thanks — I’ll notify Dedicated teams about the pause so any opt-ins can re-check.
maya: Resume scheduled at 02:15 UTC. If you own customer-facing routes and saw >250ms p95, file a quick note here.
sam: After resume, second-stage completed. One more minor p99 spike (320ms) for ~12s on route /chat-stream; counts low.
jordan: Posting raw error sample (masked):
```
ERR: conn-reset 02:14:12 host=worker-22 err=ECONNRESET
```
maya: Thanks. We'll include these traces and logs in the postmortem. Action items:
- SRE: investigate KV warmup heuristics (maya, sam)
- Runtime: re-evaluate fallback switchback timing (jordan)
- Product: notify any customers who flagged incidents (kai)
I'll open the postmortem doc and link it here after lunch: https://notes.redwood.internal/eviction-sim-1765432100-pm
Thanks everyone for quick responses :tada:
observability-bot: Post-run metrics snapshot uploaded to run: https://observability.redwood.internal/reports/eviction-sim-1765432100
maya: Closing thread for now — if you have additional signals, leave them on the postmortem doc. We’ll do a replay drill with reduced scope next week.
